decision.question: words_url and groups.json/cards.jsonl usage
options: always the task's own page url
try to match a card in cards.jsonl by slug/title for a nicer url
decision.chose: always the task's own page url (/framework/ai/<date>/<slug>/)
decision.why: cards.jsonl is a separate, newer per-day card system with no reliable link back to the dash-dated task.jsonl tasks this script reads; a fuzzy title match risked pointing an ask at the wrong card. The brief says these files are optional ('if they help place a task'); groups.json also went unused for the same reason — the seven concepts already have their own explicit match words. Left for a later pass if the owner wants richer words_url links.

decision.question: what counts toward a concept's cost_usd
options: open + done + stale (every task placed in the concept)
decision.chose: every task placed in the concept, regardless of bucket
decision.why: the owner asked 'how many tokens it took' per ask, and a concept total that silently excluded in-flight or dropped-stale spend would undercount what the concept actually cost.

decision.question: how to widen concepts without inventing new ones
options: fold the biggest unfiled groups into whichever concept reads closest
leave them unfiled and accept the count
decision.chose: folded the three biggest unfiled groups — 'pages' (70), 'layout' (91), 'review' (25) — into Page (all three are fundamentally about building, sizing or reviewing a page), and 'vision' (21) + 'website(s)' (15) into Research & Collab (both are research programs in method, just not in name)
decision.why: these five groups alone were 222 of the 331 unfiled tasks, and every sample I read (page-generator, layout-check, imagine-*-review, vision-report, capture-a) really is that concept's kind of work — widening was accurate, not just convenient. Left unfiled on purpose: instructions/notes/system-design/playground/platform/figma/audits/docs/ux and ~15 one-off groups, none of which read as any of the seven.

decision.question: View kept swallowing false positives (days-view, importance) via the bare word 'view'
options: keep 'view' as a plain lowercase word
drop it, add a case-sensitive check for capital 'View' against the request text only
decision.chose: case-sensitive 'View' check, request text only (slugs are always lowercase so the signal doesn't exist there)
decision.why: spot-checking View's done list caught 2 of 5 as wrong (days-view = a report screen, importance = 'a context view' in prose, neither is the View class) while view-tc/subclassing/proposal-followups are genuinely about the class and all three say capital 'View'. Re-running after the fix: View's done count dropped from 106 (round 1, padded by panels/web-ui) to 3, all three verified by hand.
